name: Goblin Foundry
summary: The Goblin Foundry is an industrial workshop deep within the Deadmines where goblin tinkerers manufacture heavy metalwork for the Defias Brotherhood. A massive smelting cauldron dominates the chamber, which remains occupied by goblin craftsmen and engineers under Gilnid.

sections.title: Industrial Ambitions
sections.body: Carved into the subterranean depths of Moonbrook, the Goblin Foundry provides the Defias Brotherhood with heavy manufacturing power. Goblin craftsmen and engineers work among the smelters and iron ramps, producing anchors and cannonballs.

sections.title: Gilnid's Workshop
sections.body: Gilnid presides over the foundry's goblin workforce. Craftsmen maintain production while engineers defend the workshop with remote-controlled golems, making its narrow ramps and molten metal dangerous for intruders.

faq.q: What was being built in the Goblin Foundry?
faq.answer: The goblin craftsmen produce heavy metalwork, including anchors and cannonballs, for the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why are there golems in the foundry?
faq.answer: Goblin engineers use remote-controlled golems to defend their workshop against intruders.

faq.q: Where are the goblins who ran this workshop?
faq.answer: The goblin craftsmen and engineers remain at work in the foundry under Gilnid, the smelter.

faq.q: What is the large structure in the center of the room?
faq.answer: The center of the room is dominated by a massive industrial smelting cauldron used to melt down ore hauled from the mines to forge armor plates and mechanical chassis.

angles.text: The foundry showcases goblin metalworking and mechanical ingenuity, with engineers using remote-controlled golems to defend the workshop.
The Defias workshop reveals the scale of the Brotherhood's industrial resources beneath Westfall.
